title: Markdown in a message
lead: A translation may carry **Markdown**, and `<i18n.T>` renders it as elements Svelte creates, from a closed set of nodes, with no `@html` anywhere.

payload.title: A payload is text
payload.label: Your name
payload.note: What you type brings no Markdown: a `*` or a `[` in it renders as itself, inside the strong emphasis the message itself carries.

component.title: A link as a component
component.note: This usage maps the message's `link` onto a component of the app's, which takes the link's `href` and `title` as props and its text as children.

blocks.title: Paragraphs where they fit
blocks.text:
A blank line splits a message into paragraphs, and a backslash before a line ending breaks a line:\\
like this one.

Paragraphs are off by default, since a message often sits inside a `p` or a `button`, which cannot hold one. Here this usage maps them, as it sits inside a `div`.

blocked.title: What stays text
blocked.text: This [link](javascript:alert(1)) has no address, ![a picture](/favicon.png) shows only its description, and raw HTML stays as it is written.
blocked.note: The blocked address and the unmapped image are reported through onReport: in the server's log, and in the browser's console.
